# AIU

> This site offers detailed information about AIU: Amp It Up, an all-in-one AI assistant platform for building funnels, websites, apps, and managing leads. It includes pricing details, feature descriptions, and account management options.

AIU is a comprehensive platform designed to automate and streamline online business tasks through AI-powered tools. It provides resources on how to build lead funnels, create websites and applications, and manage customer relationships—all with lifetime access for a single payment. The site also highlights partnership opportunities, referral programs, and demo offerings, making it a valuable resource for entrepreneurs and developers interested in AI-driven automation.

## Core Content

[AIU: Amp It Up — Your all-in-one AI assistant](https://www.getaiu.online)

### Features and Capabilities
- Chat-based AI assistant for building funnels, websites, and apps
- Lead capture, pipeline management, and instant lead alerts
- Affiliate dashboard for tracking referrals
- Continuous updates included in lifetime plans

### Pricing Plans
- **AIU Lifetime**: $1,999; one-time payment for all features and updates
- **AIU Partner**: $4,999/year; includes referral commissions and early access
- Monthly plans with a 7-day free trial

### How It Works
- Describe your project in plain words
- The AI assistant builds the requested funnel, website, or app
- Track views, leads, and conversions in real-time

### Lead Management & Referral Program
- Manage leads effectively
- Share referral links and earn commissions
- Monthly payouts for referrals exceeding $50
